I am currently a first-year MPhil student in the CSE department, and I have experience working on projects related to Embodied AI, giving me some background in machine learning. I am urgently looking for a group that needs members, as I just enrolled in this course.

I promise to be a hardworking and proactive group member, actively participating in group discussions and contributing to the work.

If your group needs one more member, please feel free to contact me, ntchanab@connect.ust.hk, or wechat ID: cherrychan2003.

Thank you!

https://canvas.ust.hk/courses/72132/disc.title: About proposal
https://canvas.ust.hk/courses/72132/disc.body:
Regarding the project proposal, I would like to ask about the submission procedure. Should the proposal be submitted only once by the group leader on behalf of all members, or should every group member submit it individually?  

 

Discussion replies

WONG, Raymond Chi Wing · 2026-09-23T14:55:11Z

Dear student,

  Sorry for the late reply. I just discovered this message 
in Discussion. It seems that I did not receive any email notification
about this post from Canvas. 

  Anyway, I just discovered it. Here is my reply.

Yes. Only one representative of your group should submit the proposal/report for the entire group *once* only.
The other members are not required to submit the proposal/report.
You could see the detailed guideline about this submission in this link.
https://canvas.ust.hk/courses/72132/pages/project-importantdates-submissionsites

  If you have other questions, please feel free to ask me. 

Regards,
Raymond

Must the calculator used in the final exam be able to calculate logarithms? will we have some formulas on the final paper?

Discussion replies

WONG, Raymond Chi Wing · 2026-09-23T14:53:35Z

Dear student,

  Sorry for the late reply. I just discovered this message 
in Discussion. It seems that I did not receive any email notification
about this post from Canvas. 

  Anyway, I just discovered it. Here is my reply.

1. The calculator should better support the function of computing "logarithms".
2. The formula may be given to you. We will discuss the final exam format
   near at the end of the semester. You could ask more questions about the final
   exam format at that time.

  If you have other questions, please feel free to ask me. 

Regards,
Raymond
